content:
On June 29, 2026, the Optimism project saw significant progress in deployment pipeline enhancements and L2 Genesis integration, alongside ongoing monitoring of a persistent high intrinsic gas issue on Optimism Sepolia. New features for `op-deployer` and anchor block picking are being introduced, while critical issues related to the new deployment pipeline and L2 Genesis integration were successfully closed. The team continues to track a known issue with `eth_estimateGas` on Optimism Sepolia following the Karst hard fork, with a potential fix anticipated in the next release.

## 🚨 Needs Attention
- **Urgent Discussions**:
    - **Optimism Sepolia Intrinsic Gas Issue**: The issue [#21457](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/21457) in `superchain-registry` and [#21457](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21457) in `optimism` regarding "intrinsic gas too high" on Optimism Sepolia after the Karst hard fork requires continued monitoring and input, especially regarding the related pull request [#21574](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21574) which is expected to provide a fix.

## ✅ Completed Work
### Deployment Pipeline and L2 Genesis Integration
- **Advancing the New Deployment Pipeline**: The design and architecture for a new deployment pipeline, enabling deployment with a permissionless dispute game from block 0 and resolving cyclic dependencies, has been completed and closed. [#20897](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20897)
- **Integrating L2 Contracts Manager into L2 Genesis**: A refactor to integrate `L2ContractsManager` as the source of truth for predeploy setup at L2 Genesis has been completed, streamlining the L2 genesis process. [#20903](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20903)

## 🏗️ Work in Progress
### New Pull Requests
- **ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry**:
    - [#1271](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1271) Automated codegen update.
- **ethereum-optimism/optimism**:
    - [#21601](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21601) feat(op-deployer): depset and prestate gen - Introduces new features for `op-deployer` related to depset and prestate generation.
    - [#21600](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21600) feat(pd): pick anchor block for prepare - Focuses on picking an anchor block for the prepare phase.
    - [#21599](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21599) dependabot(gomod): bump github.com/ipfs/go-datastore from 0.6.0 to 0.9.2 - Updates the `go-datastore` dependency.
    - [#21598](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21598) dependabot(gomod): bump github.com/consensys/gnark-crypto from 0.18.1 to 0.20.1 - Updates the `gnark-crypto` dependency.
    - [#21597](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21597) fix(op-preimage): preserve read and write close errors - Addresses a bug in `op-preimage` to preserve read and write close errors.
    - [#21596](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21596) fix(op-reth): drain Prometheus metric buckets in op-proofs CLI - Fixes an issue with draining Prometheus metric buckets in the `op-proofs` CLI.
    - [#21595](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21595) [codex] move scheduled tests to daily - Moves scheduled tests to a daily execution.

## 🐞 Issue Triage
### Closed Issues
- **ethereum-optimism/optimism**:
    - [#20897](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20897) Design and architecture for new deployment pipeline.
    - [#20903](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20903) Refactor to integrate `L2ContractsManager` as source of truth for predeploy setup at L2 Genesis.

## ✨ Contributor Spotlight
- **yuercl**: Provided crucial updates and confirmation on the persistence of the "intrinsic gas too high" issue on Optimism Sepolia, aiding in the ongoing monitoring and diagnosis of this critical problem.
